visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up shot of a glass window of a storefront. A large, dark brown cockroach is seen resting on the upper-right corner of the pane. A small animated graphic of a woman cheering with gold pom-poms is overlaid at the bottom. The lighting is bright from the interior of the shop. (2) The camera pans slightly as the cockroach begins to crawl upward and across the glass. Inside the booth, a male staff member in a black shirt is partially visible working. A green payment logo and Chinese characters are visible on the window surface. (3) The insect suddenly takes flight, moving directly towards the camera. The shot immediately becomes extremely shaky as the camera pans down and away in a frantic motion. The video ends with a blurry view of a gray concrete sidewalk, a red doormat, and a closed metal rolling shutter.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker provides a calm, slightly low-energy narration, expressing curiosity about a situation. The acoustic environment is quiet with a faint underlying room tone and distant street hum. (2) As he continues, his pitch rises and his speech becomes more animated. He mentions being unbothered by certain things but finds the current sight 'exciting.' His vocal intensity increases, indicating growing arousal. (3) A sudden, high-pitched scream erupts, followed by the loud, broadband sound of clothing rustling and wind buffeting the microphone. The scene concludes with the sound of rapid footsteps and frantic, higher-pitched laughter.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a comedic and relatable jump-scare video. The narrator confidently observes a large cockroach on a window, only to be immediately terrified when the insect flies toward him, subverting his initial claim of bravery.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses a first-person perspective to draw the viewer into a tense observation that resolves in a humorous, high-arousal reaction.
